claim_boundary: This protocol records a no-training fixed-geometry variational KKT kernel and one deliberately limited frozen QEq-hardness monopole tangent. Neither supplies a public Route-2 profile, a nonpolar term, a chemistry score, force, PES, or accuracy result.

construction.name: route2-v0-variational-quadratic-kkt-v1
construction.frozen_solute_source: c0(R) is the unmodified zero-reaction-field MACE-POLAR l<=1 density
construction.induced_density: delta_c is an explicit variational degree of freedom constrained by u^T delta_c=0; the legacy learned local-jet and exact-GTO response updates are forbidden
construction.electronic_functional: F_ind(delta_c)=0.5 delta_c^T H_R delta_c, where H_R is a separately declared symmetric gas-phase coefficient/dual curvature
construction.continuum_functional: G_pcm(c)=0.5 c^T P_R c from one reciprocal same-basis GTO Galerkin continuum operator
construction.joint_stationarity: (H_R + P_R) delta_c + P_R c0 + lambda u = 0, u^T delta_c = 0
construction.energy_ledger: G_ind=0.5 delta_c^T H_R delta_c; G_pcm=0.5(c0+delta_c)^T P_R(c0+delta_c); only G_ind+G_pcm is reported as the fixed-geometry solute-continuum correction

required_before_any_chemistry_score: A versioned H_R construction in the exact GTO coefficient/dual units used by the kernel.
Independent gas-phase physical provenance for every parameter or ab-initio response datum used to construct H_R.
An explicit treatment of any vacuum Coulomb, charge-transfer, hardness, polarizability, and reference-state assumptions.
A frozen record showing that no target solvation value, MNSol, FreeSolv, SMD parameter, or observed solvation error selected H_R.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not interpret an arbitrary diagonal curvature as a physical electronic model.
Do not use isolated-atom hardness or polarizability alone as evidence that a molecular curvature is adequate.
Do not infer H_R from the rejected MACE learned field update or repair that update into H_R.
Do not choose a curvature scale, cavity, or nonpolar coefficient from a development or confirmation solvation error.

rappe_goddard_hardness_same_basis_monopo.local_input_provenance: Published Rappé-Goddard QEq hardness rows from the byte-pinned local qeq.dat table; only H, Li, C, N, O, F, Na, Si, P, S, Cl, K, Br, Rb, I, and Cs are admitted.
rappe_goddard_hardness_same_basis_monopo.pair_metric: The off-diagonal vacuum Coulomb term is evaluated in the native 1.5 Angstrom MACE Gaussian monopole basis, not through a second element-radius density representation.
rappe_goddard_hardness_same_basis_monopo.response_subspace: Only l=0 monopoles vary. Every l=1 coefficient is an exact homogeneous KKT constraint, not a large penalty.
rappe_goddard_hardness_same_basis_monopo.reference_shift: QEq electronegativity is not used as a linear energy term; the model is a curvature-only tangent about frozen MACE c0 and is not full QEq.
known_limitations: It omits induced dipoles, higher multipoles, environment-dependent hardness, and explicit charge-transfer locality.
It uses the documented fixed-neutral-hydrogen Gaussian-QEq approximation rather than the original charge-dependent hydrogen parameters.
It has no nonpolar free-energy functional or total-solvation accuracy result.
not_authorized: Do not report chemical accuracy, a free-energy benchmark score, a force, PES, optimization, scan, MD, or NVE result.
Do not widen to unpublished UFF-derived QEq rows or select a parameter row from solvation error.
Do not compare its score as a one-variable response ablation against V0-FD's point-multipole source.

structural_acceptance_gates: The frozen density has the declared total charge before solving; the induced density has exactly zero total charge within the registered tolerance.
H_R is symmetric in the declared coefficient/dual pairing; material asymmetry rejects the candidate.
Q0^T H_R Q0 and Q0^T(H_R+P_R)Q0 are strictly positive definite; a failed stability gate rejects the candidate without damping or clipping.
The KKT stationarity residual and continuum same-basis half-coupling identity meet their registered numerical tolerances.
The response to an external coefficient dual is symmetric and nonpositive in the same energy pairing, and agrees with a finite-difference KKT check.
No force/PES gate is attempted before a smooth cavity and the full explicit coordinate derivative of the same scalar are available.

benchmark_policy.after_physical_curvature_binding: Follow the frozen 11-solvent development, disjoint confirmation, and external blind rules in route2-v0-fd-multisolvent-prereg-v1.json. Every record must satisfy the per-record maximum-error gate without a method change.
benchmark_policy.no_ranking_rule: V0-Q's Gaussian same-basis source is a distinct representation from the V0-FD point-multipole control. Their scores may not be ranked as a one-variable response ablation.

decision_rule: Any failed structural gate rejects that physical-curvature binding before chemistry metrics. A chemistry failure rejects the frozen binding and does not authorize an error-driven rescale, retraining, or post-hoc correction.
